title: The Morning Build for November 11, 2026: Formal Verification, Robot Vision-to-Act, and Business Profiles in ChatGPT
intro: Today’s stories focus on how AI is moving from prototypes into engineering workflows: DeepMind used an agentic system to produce machine-checked proofs of Signal’s production cryptography; Google DeepMind and Nvidia both reported robotics advances that translate vision and language into real-world control; OpenAI launched a beta Business Hub to let companies publish profiles and agents inside ChatGPT; and browser vendors published the Modern Web Guidance repo and CLI for safer coding-agent outputs.
meta_description: DeepMind formal-verifies Signal's cryptography; Nvidia's GR00T 2 maps human video to robot motion; OpenAI bets on business profiles; Gemini Robotics 2.5 pilots; Modern Web Guidance ships.

stories.headline: DeepMind introduces AlphaProof Code and publishes machine-checked proofs of Signal’s cryptographic implementation
stories.what_happened: DeepMind published AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that, with human review, generated over six million lines of Lean to formally verify key security properties of Signal’s production cryptographic code and rechecked two previously fixed real bugs. The team says the end-to-end verification took four weeks and humans only needed to re-inspect about one percent of the codebase.
stories.why_it_matters: Engineers get a concrete example where multi-LLM agents plus human experts produced machine-checked proofs that connect cryptographic design to compiled implementation, reducing manual review scope and producing artifacts intended for community use. The output is Lean proofs, not heuristic test suites, so correctness is checked by the theorem prover rather than by examples.
stories.outlook: Open-source release of the technical paper and the formal verification artifacts (the Lean proofs and repository) that DeepMind says it is publishing.

stories.headline: Nvidia publishes GR00T 2 research that converts human video demonstrations into robot control via world-action video prediction
stories.what_happened: Nvidia released GR00T 2, a world-action model trained on roughly 400,000 hours of head-mounted human video using a cluster of more than a thousand GB300 chips; the model predicts both next robot actions and short-horizon future video frames to map human motions to different robot morphologies. In lab tests, single-video transfers produced task success rates from 10 to 80 percent and, for a set of 50 tasks, under three minutes of conventional training raised median success from 40 to 95 percent.
stories.why_it_matters: The model’s video-prediction approach yields a transferable representation across form factors, allowing researchers to derive robot commands without teleoperating each robot for every task; success-rate ranges and remaining gaps, missing tactile inputs, false negatives like half-turned screws, and multi-second planning latency when paired with a higher-level language model, define current operational limits for production deployment.
stories.outlook: Published GR00T 2 research and lab metrics, including the Turbo variant running on Jetson Thor, serve as the immediate artifact to inspect for replication and latency/robustness numbers in follow-on papers or code releases.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Business Hub beta to let verified companies create profiles and deploy specialized business agents inside ChatGPT
stories.what_happened: OpenAI rolled out a Business Hub beta where eligible companies can verify and update structured profiles, view limited interaction metrics (profile views, mentions, website clicks), and create business agents that answer customer queries within ChatGPT. OpenAI said verification uses multiple methods across markets but did not publish the specific verification criteria.
stories.why_it_matters: For engineers supporting customer-facing systems, ChatGPT now presents a platform where third-party data and agent endpoints can be surfaced directly in user conversations, changing where discovery and conversational integrations may need to expose structured APIs and verification hooks when companies opt into the Hub.
stories.outlook: Ongoing Business Hub beta availability and the unspecified company verification process during the beta period are the next public milestones to track for changes in profile verification signals and agent deployment capabilities.

stories.headline: DeepMind’s Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent in a Mercedes-Benz parts-sorting pilot and ships the ASIMOV-Jailbreak safety benchmark
stories.what_happened: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, reported 30–100 percent task improvement over its previous baselines, and says Apptronik’s Apollo 2 achieved a 96 percent success rate sorting metal parts on Mercedes-Benz production lines in Hungary and Germany. DeepMind also released the ASIMOV-Jailbreak benchmark on Hugging Face and used Gemini 4 Argon to generate simulation training data.
stories.why_it_matters: Engineers working on industrial automation get a concrete production-line pilot with measured success rates and an open benchmark for prompt-based safety testing; Argon-generated simulated runs and the ASIMOV-Jailbreak dataset provide artifacts for reproducing training data generation and stress-testing model jailbreak resistance.
stories.outlook: Rollout of Gemini Robotics 2.5 to declared partners Agile, Apptronik, and Mercedes-Benz as stated by DeepMind is the next deployment milestone for observing real-world transfer and performance retention.

stories.headline: Browser vendors publish Modern Web Guidance repo and CLI to steer coding agents toward modern web APIs and patterns
stories.what_happened: The Modern Web Guidance project, stewarded by Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, published a GitHub repo and a CLI (npx modern-web-guidance@latest) that injects curated, token-efficient web platform guides into coding-agent contexts and provides a legacy-scan and retrieval APIs covering 250 web features and 203 real-world use cases.
stories.why_it_matters: Teams embedding coding agents can use the published guides and CLI to reduce legacy-pattern outputs from LLMs and to supply up-to-date browser API usage, accessibility, and performance advice directly into an agent’s context window, making generated code more aligned with current platform primitives rather than older polyfilled patterns.
stories.outlook: Updates to the Modern Web Guidance GitHub repository and the NPM package (the 'latest' npx install) are the immediate artifacts to watch for new guides, eval dashboard results, and changes to the CLI interface.

narration_script: DeepMind published AlphaProof Code, an agentic formal-verification framework that produced over six million lines of Lean to machine-check key security properties of Signal’s production cryptographic code. DeepMind reports the end-to-end run took four weeks and required human re-inspection of about one percent of the code; the team also reintroduced two historical bugs and had the system prove the buggy versions insecure. The researchers say they are open-sourcing the verification artifacts and a technical paper as the next public artifact. Nvidia released GR00T 2, a world-action model trained on roughly 400,000 hours of head-mounted human video on a cluster of more than a thousand GB300 chips. GR00T 2 predicts short-horizon future video frames and robot actions so a human demonstration can be translated to a different robot morphology. Lab results show single-video transfers producing task success rates between 10 and 80 percent, and under three minutes of conventional training raised success on 50 selected tasks from about 40 percent to 95 percent; the team notes remaining gaps around tactile sensing and planning latency when a higher-level language model is added. OpenAI launched a Business Hub beta that lets eligible companies verify profiles, view limited interaction metrics, and deploy specialized business agents inside ChatGPT; the company said verification uses multiple methods but did not publish the exact criteria. Google DeepMind also introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, reporting a 96 percent success rate for Apptronik’s Apollo 2 sorting metal parts on Mercedes-Benz production lines, and published the ASIMOV-Jailbreak benchmark and Argon-generated simulation artifacts to support training and safety testing. DeepMind says it is rolling Gemini Robotics 2.5 to partners Agile, Apptronik, and Mercedes-Benz. Finally, browser vendors published the Modern Web Guidance repository and a CLI that injects curated, token-efficient web platform guides into coding-agent contexts, with an npx install for immediate use and an eval dashboard for results. The concrete forward signals here are the open-source release of DeepMind’s AlphaProof artifacts and paper, the published GR00T 2 research and Turbo-on-Jetson details, the Business Hub beta window and its verification flow, the partner rollout of Gemini Robotics 2.5, and ongoing Modern Web Guidance repo and NPM package updates. These releases provide the artifacts engineers need to validate claims, reproduce results, and integrate the new agent and guidance tooling into production pipelines.
